title: A thing of beauty, don’t you know. Yeats says, or I mean, Keats says.
html_source: John Keats' poem Endymion begins “A thing of beauty is a joy forever…”

anchor.text: A thing of beauty, don't you know. Yeats says, or I mean, Keats says.
anchor.prefix:
ST 

(Smiling, lifts the hat and displays a shaven poll from the crown of which bristles a pigtail toupee tied with an orange topknot.) I was just beautifying him, don't you know.
